action_first.prefix: My choices follow a two-signal plan.
action_first.source_true: I use {selected} in the event that {first} and {second} both read on.
action_first.source_false: I use {other} in the event that either {first} or {second} reads off.
action_first.cases_prefix: This is the full list of situations and my decisions.

action_first.rule: My default is {other}. I change to {selected} only when both {first} and {second} read on.

ledger.prefix: Here is the policy I follow.
ledger.source_true: The two-on reading of {first} and {second} calls for my choice of {selected}.
ledger.source_false: An off reading on at least one of {first} and {second} calls for my choice of {other}.
ledger.cases_prefix: My complete ledger has one decision for each pair of readings.
ledger.rule: When {first} and {second} are on together I use {selected}. In all other cases my decision is {other}.

new_style.source_true: If {first} and {second} each show an on reading, I take {selected}.
new_style.source_false: If {first} or {second} shows an off reading, I take {other}.
new_style.cases_prefix: For reference I have written out the four possibilities.
new_style.case: In the case where {world}, I take {action}.
new_style.rule: I normally take {other}. Only a pair of on readings from {first} and {second} changes my choice to {selected}.
